description: Suspends, stops or resumes Sitecore search indexes. Omit name to act on every index in the matching state. To rebuild an index use indexing-rebuild-search-index; to read the current state use indexing-get-search-index.

action.description: suspend pauses a running index, stop halts it, resume restarts a paused one.

name.description: The index to act on. Omit to act on all indexes in the matching state.

name: indexing-set-search-index-state
